visual_synopsis: In a cold, desaturated hospital corridor a mustached surgeon in cap and gown takes a call on his mobile phone and then holds a long back-and-forth with a long-haired nurse (a male actor in a wig with lipstick). Near the end staff wheel a sheet-covered body past on a gurney, and a mustached man in a white shirt and tie speaks straight to camera from the same corridor to close the piece.
